simple.meaning: מִשְׁעֵנָה (mishʻênâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “support (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively) sustenance or (concretely) a walking-stick.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 21:19. The surrounding context includes kingship, Egypt.

simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

definitions.full: H4938. mish 'enah מַשְׁעֵנָה noun feminine id., see foregoing (masculine and feminine to exhaust the category = support of every kind). מִשְׁעֶ֫נֶת noun feminine staff ; — absolute Judg 6:21 ; 2Kin 4:31 ; construct 18:20 +; suffix מִשְׁעַנְתּוֺ Exod 21:19 ; Zech 8:4 , etc.; plural suffix מִשְׁעֲנֹתָם Num 21:18 ; — staff , Exod 21:19 (E) Num 21:18 (J) Judg 6:21 ; 2Kin 4:28 ; 4:29 ; 2 Kings 2:31; Zech 8:4 ; figurative of political support, הָרָצוּץ הַקָּנֶה מִשְׁעֶנֶת 2Kin 18:21 = Isa 36:6 , compare Ezek 29:6 ; of ׳י as shepherd Psa 23:4 (+ שֵׁבֶט ).
